paired_comparison.uncertainty_limit: Eight start-seed clusters span three layout families. Small-cluster percentile bootstrap is exploratory; repeated commands and missions are not independent worlds.
paired_comparison.conditional_limit: Travel comparisons condition on completion in both variants; survivorship bias prevents claiming unconditional speed improvement.

limits: Navigation acceptance alone is insufficient for Phase 4; all ten eligible actual-motion faults and software/CI checks are required.
Contact counts are observed physics records, not independent impacts; finite coverage does not establish collision impossibility.
No missing/unattempted request or missing state/contact record is a pass.
Each command trace uses same-session Linux BOOTTIME; no cross-kernel or simulation/realtime clock subtraction.
The matched timing segment is guard publication begin to native decode, not full controller-to-actuator latency.
